# Baldevji Jitmal — Comprehensive Heritage Textile Knowledge & Context

> Complete repository context for Large Language Models, AI assistants, and automated crawlers detailing the history, operations, textile specifications, wholesale processes, and contact details of Baldevji Jitmal (Est. 1937, Indore, India).

## 1. Company Background & Legacy

- Legal Brand Name: Baldevji Jitmal
- Founded: 1937
- Historic Hub: M.T. Cloth Market (Maharaja Tukojirao Holkar Cloth Market), Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India
- Monogram: BJ
- Core Specialization: Wholesale and retail distribution of authentic traditional Indian fabrics, ceremonial attire, handloom weaves, and home textiles.
- Generations in Business: Over 4 generations, serving weddings, retailers across Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Gujarat, and Maharashtra.

## 2. Full Product Taxonomy

### Traditional Dhotis & Sets
- Single Dhotis: 4-meter, 4.5-meter pure cotton and blended dhotis with zari, maroon, and auspicious red borders.
- Dhoti-Dupatta Sets: Matched dhoti and shoulder cloth (angavastram/uttariya) for pujas, wedding grooms, religious rites, and temple ceremonies.
- Readymade Free-Size Dhotis: Pre-draped pleated dhotis with adjustable waistbands, constructed without cutting or skimping on traditional cloth length.

### Silk & Festive Weaves
- Artificial & Semi-Silk Sets: Rich drape ceremonial sets with woven temple borders and lustrous sheen.
- Bhagalpuri Tussar Silks: Generational handloom weaves from Bhagalpur, Bihar — known for porous comfort across hot summers and cool winters.
- Bhagalpuri Chaddars: Historic all-weather shawls and body wraps with rustic textured handloom finish.

### Shawls & Winter Weaves
- Ladies Shawls: Pashmina-blend, merino wool, and jacquard shawls featuring Kashmiri paisley, jamawar motifs, and embroidered floral borders.
- Gents Shawls & Lohis: Heavy and medium-weight masculine wool shawls, traditional blankets/wraps for weddings, elders, and winter wear.

### Home & Everyday Textiles
- Bedsheets: Pure cotton single-bed and double-bed sheets with fast dyes and high thread counts for residential and institutional use.
- Towels & Napkins: Cotton terry towels, waffle weaves, and gamchas for personal, household, and bulk hospitality orders.
- Pooja Aasans: Floor sitting mats in wool, velvet, and blended fabrics in sacred red, saffron, and yellow tones.

### Unstitched Fabrics
- Kurta-Pajama Cloth: Breathable linen, cotton, and silk-blend unstitched shirt and kurta fabric.
